title: Builder matrix: Temple and Free Human quiet text under AA
detail: pnpm audit:builder-matrix (BLD-901) found 71 small-text contrast misses, all one token each. Temple kit: umber 500 #8C7059 is the text-subtle ink and reads 4.05:1 on plaster (4.48:1 on the card). Free Human: taupe 500 #85664E reads 4.48:1 on cream 100. Fix is a deeper ink for text only, the way lib/theme/temple.ts already does (#7C624D, 4.55:1) and Free Human taupe to #84654D (4.55:1); the palette steps stay for decoration. Held because lib/theme/block-contract-tokens.test.ts pins the resolved value of every core token by hash: the change needs UPDATE_CONTRACT_MAP=1 and the owner's own phrase for each of the two pin rewrites (temple-kit and free-human). Closed 2026-11-09: Daniel gave both phrases ("rewrite temple-kit pin", "rewrite free-human pin"); Temple kit text-subtle and text-muted now #7C624D, Free Human #84654D, and the two pins in lib/theme/block-contract-map.json were regenerated with UPDATE_CONTRACT_MAP=1 (two lines changed, nothing else).
